title: Evals
description: Requests, latency and cost filtered to the evals tenant. This dashboard reads the same gateway families every other dashboard reads, scoped to tenant="evals", so it renders real data as soon as the eval runner sends traffic under that tenant; the nightly eval's own gateway_eval_* score metrics (row 24, REQUIREMENTS #43) are pushed to a Pushgateway rather than tagged with a tenant, and are read by NightlyEvalRegression, not by this dashboard. Provisioned from infra/k8s/monitoring/dashboards/; edits made in the Grafana UI are not saved.

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: Requests from the evals tenant, by status. Reads empty until the eval runner sends traffic under tenant="evals".

panels.title: Latency p50 and p95, by alias
panels.description: gateway_request_latency_seconds carries no tenant label (only alias and provider), so this panel cannot be scoped to the evals tenant and shows global end-to-end latency by alias for context instead - the eval runner's own aliases will be visible here once it sends traffic.

panels.title: Cost per second
panels.description: Spend booked to the evals tenant, by provider and model. Reads empty until the eval runner sends traffic.
